description: This Java class implements a JDBC-based service for loading tenant details by their identifier within the Apache Fineract platform. It utilizes Spring Framework annotations and JDBC template to query tenant information from a database.

classes.name: AuthTenantDetailsServiceJdbc
classes.description: A JDBC implementation of the AuthTenantDetailsService interface for loading tenant details based on tenant identifier, utilizing Spring JDBC template.

methods.name: AuthTenantDetailsServiceJdbc
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JdbcTemplate with a provided DataSource, specifically qualified as 'hikariTenantDataSource'.

methods.name: loadTenantById
methods.description: Retrieves tenant details from the database for a given tenant identifier, caches the result, and throws an exception if not found.
